n = int(input())
q = list(map(int, input().split()))
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
b = list(map(int, input().split()))
ans = 0
inf = float("inf")
for x in range(max(q) + 1):
    y = inf
    for i in range(n):
        if q[i] < x * a[i]:
            y = -inf
            break
        elif b[i] > 0:
            y = min(y, (q[i] - x * a[i]) // b[i])
    ans = max(ans, x + y)
print(ans)
